seo.description: Christ-centered songs, honest stories, and lasting hope from Mississippi pastor, Christian counselor, author, and songwriter Billy Ready.

hero.title: Billy Ready
hero.intro: Every song is a prayer that your heart will be pointed to Jesus Christ.
hero.imageAlt: A well-worn acoustic guitar resting beside a church pew in warm evening light

sections.heading: Sometimes God’s answer to discouragement is another song.
sections.lead: Some songs are born out of celebration. Others come through disappointment, unanswered prayers, and quiet moments when God whispers, “Keep going.”
sections.body:
After a deeply discouraging response to one of his songs, Billy seriously considered laying songwriting aside. Instead, God began filling his heart with new melodies—reminders that the calling had not changed.

[Read the story of He Keeps Me Singing](/songs/he-keeps-me-singing)

sections.heading: Hope for the road you’re walking.

sections.quote: God’s faithfulness is greater than life’s greatest storms.

sections.heading: More than a concert.
sections.intro: Based in Mississippi, Billy partners with churches and Christian organizations for gatherings centered on worship, God’s Word, and His faithfulness.

sections.body: For decades, God has allowed Billy to serve people through pastoral ministry, Christian counseling, writing, and music—all with one purpose: helping people discover God’s faithfulness in every season of life.

sections.heading: A little encouragement for the journey.
sections.body: Receive occasional devotionals, behind-the-song stories, ministry updates, and new music announcements.
